title: US Treasury’s FinCEN Disconnects Systems Following Cyber Incident
description: The US Treasury's Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) experienced a cybersecurity incident resulting in unauthorized access to a limited subset of its systems. As a precaution, FinCEN disconnected some systems and extended filing deadlines due to service disruptions. The agency has not disclosed details about the nature of the incident, the attacker, or whether any data was accessed or stolen. FinCEN is actively investigating and working to restore normal operations. This incident occurred amid a series of cyberattacks affecting multiple US government agencies.
